sections.title: Data controller
body: SRAGROUP S.r.l., registered office at [address], VAT No. [number], is the controller of personal data collected through this website.

sections.title: Data we process
body: Browsing data collected automatically by the website's IT systems.
Data you provide through the contact form: first and last name, company, job title, email, phone, message content and any attachments.

sections.title: Purposes and legal basis
body: Answering requests for information and quotes (pre-contractual measures, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Sending marketing communications, only with your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

sections.title: How and how long we keep data
body: Data is processed electronically with appropriate security measures.
Request data is kept for [period] after the enquiry is closed; marketing data until consent is withdrawn.

sections.title: Recipients
body: Data may be shared with providers acting as processors (hosting, CRM, IT support) and is never made public.
Any transfer outside the EU complies with Articles 44 et seq. GDPR.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may at any time exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection (Articles 15–22 GDPR), and withdraw consent.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali).

sections.title: What cookies are
body: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device to remember information about your visit.

sections.title: Strictly necessary cookies
body: Required for the website to work and to remember your cookie preferences. They do not require consent.

sections.title: Analytics cookies
body: Used only with your consent to collect aggregated statistics on how the site is used. Provider: [to be confirmed, e.g. Google Analytics 4].

sections.title: Marketing and third-party cookies
body: Used only with your consent to measure campaigns and display third-party content such as Google Maps. Providers: [to be confirmed].

sections.title: Managing your preferences
body: You can change or withdraw consent at any time using the "Cookie preferences" link in the site footer, or through your browser settings.

sections.title: Contact
body: For information about our use of cookies, write to privacy@sragroup.it.
